Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music | National KiDi to headline first ‘Crazy World’ concert at Ghud Park on December 4 Source : Prince Adu-Owusu 5 November 2026 2:44pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Award-winning Ghanaian musician KiDi is set to stage his first flagship headline concert, dubbed Crazy World , on Friday, December 4, 2026, at Ghud Park, Accra Mall.
The concert, scheduled for the Farmers’ Day holiday, will feature interactive installations, immersive entertainment zones and a festival-style experience as the musician seeks to offer fans a different live music experience.
The announcement follows KiDi’s sold-out headline concert in London, where he delivered what organisers described as an electric live performance.
For the past three years, the musician has hosted the Likor on the Beach series at Polo Beach Club, attracting audiences and surprise performances from artistes including King Promise, Stonebwoy and Ofori Amponsah.
However, Crazy World marks an expansion of that experience from an intimate beachside gathering into a large-scale concert designed to usher in the December festivities.
KiDi describes the show as “different on every level”, saying it will reflect his broader creative identity beyond the familiar Lover Boy and playboy persona associated with his music.
The concert will also draw on the creative direction of his latest album era, Where Do We Go From Here? , while retaining the smooth sound that has endeared him to fans.
Organisers say the event is being designed as a shared social experience, with ticket packages available for couples, groups and families, alongside options for individual concertgoers.
Early Bird tickets have sold out following what organisers say has been overwhelming demand. General Admission and VIP tickets are now available.
Tickets can be purchased online at crazyworld.live , while fans can also dial *714*567# on all networks to buy tickets.
Crazy World is a KiDi live experience brought to audiences by Black Boy Joy Music and powered by Rhythms Africa.
